DEMO-001.title: Display the login form
DEMO-001.description: The Release Demo application provides a login page where a user can enter a username and password to access the task list.
DEMO-001.expectedResult: The page at `/` shows the heading `Sign in to Release Demo`, a username field labelled `Username`, a password field labelled `Password`, and a button labelled `Sign in`.

DEMO-002.title: Log in with the demo account
DEMO-002.description: A user can access the task list by submitting the single configured demo account's valid credentials.
DEMO-002.expectedResult: When the user enters the demo account's username and password and clicks `Sign in`, the application navigates to `/tasks.html` and displays the heading `My Tasks`.

negativeCases.expectedOutcome: login is prevented, the page remains at `/`, and the message `Username is required.` is displayed.
login is prevented, the page remains at `/`, and the message `Password is required.` is displayed.
signing in with the demo account's username and the password `wrong-password` is prevented, the page remains at `/`, and the message `Username or password is incorrect.` is displayed.

sourceReference.section: DEMO-002: Log in with the demo account

DEMO-003.title: Display the predefined task list
DEMO-003.description: After a successful login, the task list page displays a small, predictable set of initial tasks.
DEMO-003.expectedResult: The `/tasks.html` page displays all three task titles: `Prepare release notes`, `Review test results`, and `Approve deployment`.

sourceReference.section: DEMO-003: Display the predefined task list

DEMO-004.title: Add a task with a required title
DEMO-004.description: A signed-in user can add a task by entering a non-empty title in the task form.
DEMO-004.expectedResult: The `/tasks.html` page shows a text field labelled `Task title` with the placeholder `Enter a task title` and a button labelled `Add task`. When the user enters `Check deployment logs` and clicks `Add task`, `Check deployment logs` appears in the task list.

negativeCases.expectedOutcome: no task is added and the message `Task title is required.` is displayed.

sourceReference.section: DEMO-004: Add a task with a required title
